newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul creditors mull Jinro loans of 36.9 bln won.
newsitem.headline: Seoul creditors mull Jinro loans of 36.9 bln won.

text.p: Creditor banks are considering supplying 36.9 billion won to troubled Jinro Ltd and extending principal payments until September 1998, Jinro's major creditor Commercial Bank of Korea said on Friday.
The final decision would be made at a Jinro Group creditors' meeting at 0530 GMT, a bank spokesman said.
He said the loan, if finalised, would be made on the condition that the Jinro Group chairman hands in a memorandum giving up his management rights to Jinro Ltd.
The spokesman said the loan amount requested by Jinro Ltd had not been disclosed.
